test_layer_stack_equivalence: test that layer_stack produces the same output as an unrolled loop of Haiku layers
test_layer_stack_multi_args: test layer_stack with a function that takes multiple arguments and returns multiple outputs
test_layer_stack_grads: test that layer_stack gradients match the equivalent unrolled stack gradients
test_layer_stack_random: test that random number generation is handled correctly across stacked layers
test_layer_stack_with_state: test layer_stack with per-layer state threading using the with_state flag
